newsitem.title: USA: Westingouse gets $10 mln Chernobyl contract.
newsitem.headline: Westingouse gets $10 mln Chernobyl contract.

text.p: Westinghouse Electric Corp said it has won a $10 million contract to manage implementation of $125 million in operational and safety improvements at the Chernobyl nuclear power plant in Ukraine.

Under terms of the contract, Westinghouse said that it and two subcontractors -- National Nuclear Corp of the United Kingdom and the Kiev Design Institute of Ukraine -- will establish and operate a project management unit which will provide integrated project management and engineering support services for 15 safety projects for Chernobyl Unit 3.

The company said the unit will also include personnel from the Chernobyl site, and will coordinate construction of a liquid radioactive waste treatment plant and a spent fuel interim storage facility in preparation for decommissioning of all units at the site.
The project is being funded by a grant from the Nuclear Safety Account of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development.
